reason: I already pay for Bitrix24 and it works, even if it is slow. Moving all my clients to a company with 1 to 5 customers and no references is a big risk for me, and $29 is a real amount on my income.
objection: Is my customer data safe on your server, and are there backups? You are new, nobody I know uses you, and if you disappear I lose my clients.
